items.title: 新输入的 AI / CurseForge API Key 明文显示
items.disposition: Implemented: `SecretInput` defaults to a real `PasswordBox`, offers explicit reveal/hide, and hides again when unloaded. Existing stored-key hints remain available without returning the secret.

items.title: 皮肤站登录关闭弹窗后才校验必填项
items.disposition: Implemented: skin-site login uses `Dlg.EditAsync`; API/user/password checks and normalized-address errors stay in the open form with entered values retained.

items.title: 统一通行证的服务器 ID 校验发生在弹窗关闭后
items.disposition: Implemented: unified-pass login validates server ID/user/password in the open form before starting its task.

items.title: 微软验证码未返回时复制与打开浏览器按钮已可点
items.disposition: Implemented: device-code copy/browser controls start disabled, then become available only when the actual code/HTTPS address arrives.

items.title: 设备登录缺少倒计时与就地重新取码
items.disposition: Implemented: shared authentication events carry optional `expires_in`; WPF counts down the real TTL, disables expired actions and offers a fresh authorization. Missing TTL is explicitly unknown rather than fabricated.

items.title: 账号 UUID 行缺少完整值复制入口
items.disposition: Implemented: complete UUID is wrapped and can be copied from the account row.

items.title: 账号列表缺少按名称或类型查找
items.disposition: Implemented: account name/UUID text search and type filter.

items.title: 长账号名与固定右侧操作在窄窗下可能拥挤
items.disposition: Implemented: the account hero/list stack at narrow width; account title/actions use wrapping responsive rows. No claim of every display/scale combination.

items.title: 收藏读取失败会回退为空收藏
items.disposition: Implemented: favorites use acknowledged RPC; read failure is an explicit retryable error, not an empty collection.

items.title: 模组启停失败后开关不回滚且缺行内错误
items.disposition: Implemented: mod toggles await their commit, freeze duplicate input, roll back on failure, and report the row error; state text changes only after acknowledgement.

items.title: 搜索开始用骨架屏替换全部旧结果
items.disposition: Implemented: resource refresh retains visible rows with an updating/stale notice; a failed update keeps the previous result available.

items.title: 资源搜索固定九秒超时，慢网络只能重试
items.disposition: Implemented: a timed-out search offers an explicit 45-second retry/wait with the same criteria. Normal default remains nine seconds.

items.title: 游戏版本下拉推荐列表写死
items.disposition: Implemented: the version filter is refreshed from the manifest's release list, while preserving editable input and the existing fallback choices if unavailable.

items.title: 打开资源页会自动读取剪贴板并使用识别链接
items.disposition: Implemented: recognized clipboard links require an explicit use/ignore decision before changing the search input.

items.title: 混合来源搜索缺少各来源状态
items.disposition: Implemented: provider completion/failure metadata is preserved through `SearchCatalog` and displayed; the existing source selector supports retrying one provider. UI does not invent source status.

items.title: 已安装资源删除没有回收或撤销窗口
items.disposition: Implemented for all actual removable catalog files (mod/resourcepack/shader/datapack): move to the instance recycle store and offer undo; root's receipt/hash/no-overwrite checks protect restoration. The world catalog has no installed/delete method, so it is not a permanently deleting path; modpack label removal retains its separate semantics and keeps game data.

items.title: 最近游玩排序只加载二十四个实例的时间
items.disposition: Implemented: recent metadata request scales to the full instance list (shared backend cap raised to 10,000 by root).

items.title: 排序和只看固定筛选的偏好不随其它库偏好保存
items.disposition: Implemented: sort and pinned-only preference persist alongside group/view preferences, with old preference files remaining compatible.

items.title: 实例卡片全部创建，缺少可见区域虚拟化
items.disposition: Implemented: responsive rows use a real recycling virtualizing ListBox. Direct access to record 2000, repeated scrolling, compact view and keyboard traversal keep realized cards bounded by the viewport; all filtered records remain selectable.

items.title: 打开启动页会隐含将实例设为全局默认
items.disposition: Implemented: opening the launch page selects its target without modifying the global default instance.

items.title: 批量固定操作包含被筛选隐藏的已选实例
items.disposition: Implemented: batch pin/unpin shows the exact target names/count and the number hidden from the current page before committing.

items.title: 实例列表移除了默认焦点视觉，键盘定位需复核
items.disposition: Implemented: default keyboard focus visual restored; existing arrow/Enter navigation remains intact. Screen-reader certification is not claimed.

items.title: 版本列表双击会直接安装
items.disposition: Implemented: double-click selects/focuses the install confirmation rather than submitting installation.

items.title: 安装期间连版本搜索和浏览一起禁用
items.disposition: Implemented: an active installation locks only its mutable target/configuration; version browsing, text search and category filtering remain available.

items.title: 版本列表固定为二百九十像素高
items.disposition: Implemented: version-list height follows available viewport height within bounded limits.

items.title: 安装前没有下载量和磁盘占用摘要
items.disposition: Implemented: explicit pre-install confirmation shows `InstallationPlan` destination, known client/library download estimate, available disk space and existing-file policy. Missing estimates are labeled unknown and require an explicit continue; known insufficient space refuses submission. Assets/Java/loader exclusions remain explicit.

items.title: 加载器折叠项与禁用选项的兼容原因不够直观
items.disposition: Implemented: loader options start expanded and disabled options explain their compatibility/loading/active-task reason.

items.title: 保存设置可能先改目录、后续保存失败而部分生效
items.disposition: Implemented: directory, general settings, language, multi-instance and WPF appearance use one validated save_settings RPC and one atomic configuration replacement. File promotion failure preserves both the prior memory snapshot and disk bytes. Input is locked during the request; failure retains the draft. Lost acknowledgement is reported as unknown rather than claiming rollback.

items.title: 非法分辨率或限速数字会静默回退默认值
items.disposition: Implemented: resolution and download-rate values reject invalid/out-of-range input at the field; correction clears its error decoration.

items.title: AI 上下文非法或越界值会静默回退或截断
items.disposition: Implemented: context-window input requires a value in the documented range, without silent clamping/defaulting.

items.title: 设置混合即时、保存后和重启后生效规则
items.disposition: Implemented: effect timing and pending changes are visible. Background refresh preserves dirty drafts; directory browsing only fills the draft. Explicit theme loading confirms draft replacement, selection alone is not dirty, and successful loads refresh the form. Appearance writes use the bridge rather than a GUI configuration snapshot.

items.title: 大量设置项缺少文字搜索和定位
items.disposition: Implemented: settings search returns category-linked text matches that switch the category and scroll to the matching field.

items.title: AI 对话搜索只查标题，不查正文
items.disposition: Implemented: conversation search matches titles and message content.

items.title: AI 历史右键删除没有确认或撤销
items.disposition: Implemented: chat deletion requires a specific confirmation and acknowledged RPC; delete errors are not silently converted to old state.

items.title: AI 历史搜索重建全部按钮，缺少虚拟化
items.disposition: Implemented: AI history is an actual recycling virtual `ListBox`, with rows built by the existing virtual-row factory rather than thousands of eagerly constructed buttons.

items.title: 导入整合包入口实际打开线上资源搜索
items.disposition: Rename the misleading import entry to “查找整合包”; it continues to open online modpack search.

items.title: 通知铃铛只写状态，没有通知或任务中心
items.disposition: Bell opens a local task centre, showing current and up to 100 recent operations, target, progress and outcome; active operations can be cancelled.

items.title: 搜索与筛选图标执行完全相同动作
items.disposition: Search icon always reveals and focuses keyword input; filter icon independently expands/collapses filters.

items.title: 资源兼容目标藏在默认收起的筛选区
items.disposition: Compatibility target is outside the collapsed filter area and remains visible above the list.

items.title: 新搜索先清空旧列表，失败后无法继续查看旧结果
items.disposition: New searches retain the last successful list; failure/cancellation shows a retry message without erasing it. Filter changes mark results stale and prevent wrong-target selection.

items.title: 资源搜索最多三十条，没有下一页入口
items.disposition: Implemented: load-more requests use real offset/pageSize. Shared Modrinth rows carry project_id as canonical id; mobile deduplication also supports legacy blank-ID rows using slug. Nonempty pages allow continuing; only empty upstream pages end pagination.

items.title: 资源详情返回后不恢复列表滚动位置
items.disposition: Resource-list offset is saved before entering details and restored on return.

items.title: 资源文件默认选第一项，推荐依据不清楚
items.disposition: Implemented: download summary shows recommendation basis, file name/date/compatibility. Release responses bind project, instance, version, loader and all search filters; changed context cannot reactivate old files.

items.title: 资源下载只在全局状态文本中展示进度
items.disposition: Resource progress includes project/file and completed/total where available; local task centre retains terminal result.

items.title: 搜索、文件加载和下载会禁用整页与底部导航
items.disposition: Resource operations no longer disable page or bottom navigation. Conflicting actions report the active task instead of silently returning.

items.title: 实例表单校验错误只出现在全局状态条
items.disposition: Name/version errors appear next to their form and focus the invalid input. Names reject path/control characters.

items.title: 离开实例编辑页没有未保存提醒
items.disposition: Implemented: leaving an edited instance requires a target-specific discard decision. Cancel keeps both the draft and the navigation-history entry. Cover import and ZIP export also capture instance and navigation revisions across picker awaits.

items.title: 创建与编辑版本主要依靠手工输入
items.disposition: Create/edit version fields retain manual input plus a bounded, cancellable official release picker; modern `26.x` IDs are accepted.

items.title: 参考加载器可被误解为已安装加载器
items.disposition: Instance form explains that reference version/loader only filter resources and do not install a game/loader kernel.

items.title: 微软授权有效期仅显示获取时的静态分钟数
items.disposition: Device-code panel has a one-second real countdown and explicit expired/restart wording; cancellation stops it.

items.title: AI 流式更新强制滚到底，打断历史阅读
items.disposition: AI follows only when the user is near the bottom, otherwise exposes “回到最新消息”.

items.title: AI 失败后没有就地重试或编辑重发
items.disposition: Failed AI prompt returns to draft and offers retry/edit actions.

items.title: 清空聊天没有确认或撤销
items.disposition: Clear chat requires explicit confirmation and supports undo.

items.title: AI 回复按纯文本呈现，缺代码块操作
items.disposition: Chat renderer separates fenced code, headings and lists; code has clipboard action and HTTPS links have explicit browser buttons.

items.title: AI 对话只存内存，保存范围缺少明确提示
items.disposition: Bounded local `mobile-chat.json` persists at most 48 entries with a clear on-device storage notice; interrupted replies restore as stopped.

items.title: 远程配对要求跨设备手工粘贴两份 JSON
items.disposition: Pairing adds bounded JSON file import and public-offer file export, retaining explicit fingerprint confirmation and existing validation.

items.title: 撤权确认勾选没有绑定到具体设备
items.disposition: Revoke prompts with the exact target name and fingerprint, replacing the list-global checkbox as the active confirmation.

items.title: 邀请只显示保存或过期状态，不显示到期时刻
items.disposition: Selected computer shows room-ticket and renewal-subscription expiry times separately.

items.title: 周期刷新重建所有行，读屏与键盘焦点可能跳动
items.disposition: Remote host/task rows are keyed by stable IDs, updated in place and only inserted/removed when identity/order changes.

items.title: 诊断字段直接显示内部英文 key
items.disposition: Diagnostic fields use Chinese labels, with technical keys retained only in the data model.

items.title: 固定高度 JSON 框叠在整页滚动中
items.disposition: JSON is a collapsible technical section, with larger flexible bounds; field selection stays primary.

items.title: 图标与内联按钮的可视尺寸偏小，触控命中区待测
items.disposition: Implemented: relevant primary, tablet-navigation and icon controls have at least 44 logical-pixel touch targets. Desktop-hosted geometry checks do not certify physical-device touch or TalkBack.

items.title: 资源获取按钮的辅助名称不含项目名
items.disposition: Resource-row action accessible name includes its bound project title.

items.title: 小字号与 Android 大字体适配尚需专项验收
items.disposition: Android system FontScale is read and combined with a saved app 100/125/150/200% preference; text sizes are enlarged and labels wrap.

items.title: Android 系统返回没有显式应用页栈接线
items.disposition: TopLevel.BackRequested and Escape feed a page stack, resource-detail back and confirmation dismissal.

items.title: 刘海、状态栏与手势区安全边距尚未真机验收
items.disposition: InsetsManager safe-area changes update Android padding, with duplicate automatic padding disabled.

items.title: 软键盘可能压缩或遮挡页底输入区域
items.disposition: Android requests AdjustResize; InputPane events hide phone navigation while keyboard is open and reveal focused input.

items.title: 删除世界存档没有前端二次确认或撤销
items.disposition: World deletion now confirms the exact instance and world, with explicit backup/recovery warning.

items.title: 备份还原直接覆盖，缺少还原前摘要
items.disposition: Restore shows the target, backup and current-world modification information before overwrite confirmation.

items.title: 删除备份缺少确认和撤销
items.disposition: Backup deletion confirms the backup name and size/details and warns about removing the only recovery point.

items.title: 删除模组或资源文件缺少前端确认
items.disposition: Mod/resource deletion confirms instance, resource kind and filename, with explicit recovery guidance.

items.title: 服务器移除立即生效，没有撤销
items.disposition: Server removal confirms the record and exposes a one-record undo retaining its name, address, port and description.

items.title: 全部启停模组忽略当前搜索范围
items.disposition: Batch mod enable/disable evaluates the current filter at execution time. Hidden resources remain untouched; buttons say current filter.

items.title: 分析实例日志会直接发送，缺少上传前内容预览
items.disposition: Implemented: cloud log analysis requires an asynchronous bounded preview and explicit upload confirmation. Filtering covers common secret lines, URLs, local paths including spaces, email, IPv4/IPv6 and punctuation boundaries. Ambiguous unquoted paths conservatively hide the remaining line. Filtering is not a guarantee that arbitrary identifiers are removed; preview consent remains required.

items.title: 日志分析在 UI 线程读取整个文件后取尾部
items.disposition: Implemented: bounded tail reads and redaction run outside the UI thread. Both success and failure responses bind instance, file and request revision, preventing old-instance errors from replacing current content.

items.title: AI 请求前清空草稿，失败后不恢复输入
items.disposition: Implemented: failed AI sends restore the prompt when the input is empty. Successful sends clear the previous retry prompt; retry preserves any newer user draft.

items.title: AI 流式更新强制滚到底
items.disposition: Streaming follows only if the reader was near the bottom. A jump-to-latest control appears when reading older content.

items.title: AI 输出没有 Markdown 和代码块结构
items.disposition: AI document rendering now distinguishes headings, lists as separate readable lines, fenced monospace code with copying, and explicit safe HTTP(S) link buttons.

items.title: 清空 AI 会话没有确认或撤销
items.disposition: Clearing a conversation requires confirmation. Declining preserves it.

items.title: AI 配置加载失败只展开设置，不解释原因
items.disposition: AI initialization failure shows a safe configuration/key-store repair hint and logs only the exception type.

items.title: 下载忙状态会把资源页与实例页整体禁用
items.disposition: Library and resource pages remain browseable while a task runs; conflicting writes still go through the owner gate.

items.title: 忙时部分可点动作进入 RunTask 后直接返回
items.disposition: Clicking a blocked action reports the currently running task instead of silently doing nothing.

items.title: 忙时允许导航却跳过刷新，旧内容未标记
items.disposition: Navigating during work labels data as pending refresh; task completion refreshes the visible page.

items.title: 危险操作页隐藏当前实例副标题
items.disposition: Full target-instance text is restored on world/mod/server pages and in the page chrome, with wrapping/tooltip.

items.title: 左侧完整导航与顶部分类导航重复
items.disposition: Repeated top-level segmented navigation is hidden; the side navigation is the single main location model.

items.title: 窄窗固定二百零八像素侧栏挤压主内容
items.disposition: The side rail narrows from 208 to 164 pixels below 1000px window width.

items.title: 窄窗设置入口滚到侧栏底部才容易看到
items.disposition: Settings is fixed outside the scrolling navigation list.

items.title: 十至十一点五像素辅助文字的可读性待测
items.disposition: An explicit readable-text setting raises small labels to at least 13px and scales other labels. Actual native screen-reader/high-contrast certification is not claimed.

items.title: 实例图标操作只有 Tooltip，读屏名称待验证
items.disposition: Instance mod/save icon buttons have explicit names including the instance name. Native screen-reader behavior still needs device testing.

items.title: 改筛选清空结果，还需要再次点击搜索
items.disposition: Filter changes retain the previous result list and trigger a safe refresh; failures retain those results with an error notice.

items.title: 窄窗资源推荐区仍固定四列
items.disposition: Resource discovery uses two columns below its narrow breakpoint and four when there is room.

items.title: 固定宽度来源和排序挤压关键词输入框
items.disposition: Source/sort controls move to a second row in narrow layouts; the query uses the available first-row width.

items.title: 资源详情缺 WPF 已有的图库和完整介绍入口
items.disposition: Implemented: real upstream gallery, full body and selected-file changelog. Requests bind project, filters, release id and an independent revision, including A-B-A changes; pending work loads the latest selection after the current task. Failed/canceled documents support retry without an infinite loading state.

items.title: 资源列表有数量截断，却没有继续加载入口
items.disposition: Real offset/page-size requests back previous/next paging. No fictional total is shown; next remains available for every nonempty batch because alias deduplication can shorten a page before upstream exhaustion.

items.title: 任务日志详情固定一百五十六像素高
items.disposition: Task logs have copy and expand/collapse actions and a larger initial area.

items.title: 任务历史只保留本次进程、最多一百条
items.disposition: Up to 100 terminal tasks survive restart in an atomically replaced, bounded, redacted local JSON history. Running tasks are not resurrected; corrupt files remain intact and are reported.

items.title: 失败任务没有受限的就地重试入口
items.disposition: Only explicit read/refresh operations get a retry capability. Deletes, overwrite, login, game launching and arbitrary operations are never replayed through this control.

items.title: Java 按钮写设为默认，实际绑定当前实例
items.disposition: Java wording is now “用于当前实例”, matching its effect.

items.title: 安装确认区缺目标路径、磁盘和已有版本处理摘要
items.disposition: Version installation reads the typed upstream plan in the background and confirms target, published download bytes, free space and existing-file policy. Unknown parts remain labelled unknown; known insufficient space blocks installation. Failure allows cancel/retry or an explicit continue, not an invented estimate.

items.title: 三端导航名称、设置分组与主要动作不一致
items.disposition: Primary navigation concepts align across the clients: launch, instances, resources, AI assistant and settings. Mobile labels distinguish resource preparation from unavailable local game execution.

recheck_scope: Residual behavior checks supplement the original 100-item mapping; this does not claim 100 independent native-device certifications.
